_comment: Reference config for hkex_li_daily_factor_monitor. Copy to your config directory (see SKILL.md) and edit. Every URL / keyword / tab identifier lives here so the code below never hard-codes them.
_hkex_search_endpoint_note: HKEXnews title-search JSON servlet. We query a recent DATE WINDOW (not the servlet's title= param, which needs exact document-type codes and returns 0 for free text) and then filter the returned records client-side. This is resilient to HKEX category-code drift.
_hkex_search_params_note: Passed verbatim as the query string; fromDate/toDate are added at run time from days_back. rowRange=2000 comfortably covers a multi-day SEHK window.
_headline_keyword_note: Case-insensitive substring matched against each record's TITLE. This is the L&I daily-factor announcement headline.
category_keyword: Matters relating to Collective Investment Schemes
_category_keyword_note: Case-insensitive substring matched against each record's LONG_TEXT (the HKEXnews headline category = 'OTHERS (FUNDS, ETC)' -> 'Announcements and Notices - [Matters relating to Collective Investment Schemes]'). Second gate so unrelated hits on the headline keyword are dropped.
_days_back_note: Recent HKEXnews window to scan. Default 7. run_mode is 'latest' unless overridden.
_run_mode_note: 'latest' = keep only the single most-recent matching announcement per manager/PDF set (default). 'all' = keep every matching announcement in the window.
_tmp_dir_note: Scratch dir for downloaded PDFs. ALL files here are deleted at the end of every run (HKEX PDFs are copyright; nothing is retained). Override with HKEX_LI_MONITOR_HOME/work if /tmp is locked down.
